- docs/FLIXO-ENGINEERING-CONTRACTS.md:L5 — policy-or-contract-candidate — The only public agent surface is `FLIXO_AGENT`. Internal specialists are implementation details and cannot be selected through the public request contract.
- docs/FLIXO-ENGINEERING-CONTRACTS.md:L7 — policy-or-contract-candidate — ## Contract B — Canonical registries
- docs/FLIXO-ENGINEERING-CONTRACTS.md:L9 — policy-or-contract-candidate — `TOOL_CATALOG` / capability registry is the single execution authority. Model governance is the single model-admission authority. Protocol adapters such as MCP, when introduced, must not create a competing registry.
- docs/FLIXO-ENGINEERING-CONTRACTS.md:L11 — policy-or-contract-candidate — ## Contract C — Model output is data
- docs/FLIXO-ENGINEERING-CONTRACTS.md:L13 — policy-or-contract-candidate — LLM output is untrusted data. It must be parsed, schema-validated, value-validated, semantically validated and reconciled with the canonical deterministic boundary before execution.

- docs/FLIXO-ENGINEERING-CONTRACTS.md:L21 — policy-or-contract-candidate — Errors use structured fields: `code`, `recoverable`, `retryable`, `suggestedAction`, and optional execution/provider/capability identity. Recovery must be bounded and explicit.

- docs/FLIXO-ENGINEERING-CONTRACTS.md:L25 — policy-or-contract-candidate — A state-changing execution has an `executionId`, `idempotencyKey`, and stable input identity. Repeating the same key/input must resolve to the same execution identity.

- docs/FLIXO-ENGINEERING-CONTRACTS.md:L29 — policy-or-contract-candidate — Trace data records decisions and identities, not raw user file bytes or secrets. The trace must make model selection, tool selection, verification and fallback auditable.
